Framed stills: a product-demo and a text-media scene for each frame, with cover
and contain. A still is held for its scene, with no sound and no source range.

::: {.scene component="product-demo" duration="2s"}
::: {.video src="assets/landscape.jpg" placement="framed" frame="browser" fit="cover" alt="A landscape still in a browser frame"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Browser frame: a 3:2 still in cover, cropped to the 16:9 screen.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="product-demo" duration="2s"}
::: {.video src="assets/portrait.png" placement="framed" frame="phone" fit="contain" alt="A portrait still in a phone frame"}
:::

::: {.caption}
Phone frame: a 3:4 still in contain, with bars on the 9:16 screen.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="text-media" duration="2s"}
::: {.video src="assets/landscape.jpg" placement="framed" frame="browser" fit="contain" alt="A landscape still in a browser frame"}
:::

::: {.text}
A still beside its text, in contain.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="text-media" duration="2s" side="left"}
::: {.video src="assets/portrait.png" placement="framed" frame="phone" fit="cover" alt="A portrait still in a phone frame"}

The footage on the left, in cover.
